quote: the presence of a single dissenter tremendously reduced the incidence
content: Replication check: the Asch effect replicates. A close replication seventy years later (Franzen & Mader 2023) found conformity on 33% of critical trials, almost exactly Asch's rate, falling to 25% when accuracy was paid. The dissenting-partner effect cited here was reproduced in follow-up experiments (Allen & Levine 1971), and a meta-analysis of Asch-paradigm studies (Bond & Smith 1996) found conformity varies by culture and declined in the US after the 1950s. The essay's use of the study is on solid ground.
